'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Terwilliger LS Restore Freedom To The Galaxy''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Terwilliger]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-restorefreedomtothegalaxy-pre.gif|label=Restore Freedom To The Galaxy}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
